info.title: EMASS Toolkit API
info.description: EMASS Toolkit backend API. All responses use the envelope `{ success, statusCode, message, data? }`.

post.summary: Rule on a file before it uploads (creating DEV; DRAFT or CHANGES_REQUESTED)
post.description: Stateless byte-range loop. Send name and size; answer NEED_BYTES by resending with the requested ranges (base64, 64 KiB-aligned, at most 7 MiB in total) until the server rules. Without sha256 only the version rules run (NEED_HASH); with it, the content rules too (ALLOWED). Installers (PE, DEB, PKG): identical bytes anywhere or another version block. Docs and other files: only identical bytes in this release block; another version is a warning. Damaged files always block.

requestBody.description: The file, by name and size, plus the byte ranges asked for so far

replace.description: The file this one would replace

200.description: A verdict, or the ranges still needed

403.description: Not allowed for this role or user

409.description: Blocked (details.reasons: SAME_CONTENT, VERSION_MISMATCH, VERSION_EXISTS, DAMAGED) or wrong status

post.summary: Open (or find) a resumable upload for one file (creating DEV; DRAFT or CHANGES_REQUESTED)
post.description: Call after /files/check allowed the file. Opens a storage multipart upload and returns its session; the same sha256 again returns the existing session (that's how a client resumes after losing the id). Then send the parts in order and complete. The same bytes already in this release are refused here; every other rule runs on the stored object at complete. Sessions untouched for 24 h are aborted.

sha256.description: What the browser hashed; checked again at complete

platform.description: Required with kind=SDK; not allowed otherwise

replace.description: Replace this file (the one holding the platform) once the upload completes

403.description: Not allowed for this role or user

get.summary: The creating DEV's open uploads for a release
get.description: So a client can rebuild its state after a refresh. Stale sessions are aborted first.

put.summary: Send part n of an upload (in order)
put.description: Raw application/octet-stream body of exactly partSize bytes (the last part: what remains). Only part partsDone + 1 is stored; a part already stored is acknowledged (200, idempotent); a later one is 409 PART_OUT_OF_ORDER with details.expected.

403.description: Not allowed for this role or user

post.summary: Finish an upload: verify, store and save the file
post.description: Every part must have arrived. The whole-file SHA-256 must equal the declared one (else 422 CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, and the upload is discarded). The stored object is then inspected (ranged reads) and judged by the same rules as /files/check; a blocked file is deleted and refused with 409 FILE_BLOCKED. Either way the session ends. A second complete while one runs is 409 UPLOAD_COMPLETING.
